errors.text_span: Делът на населението под линията на бедност е 23.0% през 2016 г., 21.0% през 2017 г., 19.0% през 2018 г., 23.0% през 2019 г. и 25.0% през 2020 г.
errors.evidence: The values reported for the percentage of the population below the poverty line (red line) are incorrect for several years. In 2017, the value is approximately 23.6%, not 21.0%. In 2018, the value is 22.0%, not 19.0%. In 2020, the value is approximately 23.8%, not 25.0%.

errors.text_span: Червената линия показва общ възходящ тренд
errors.evidence: The description identifies a 'general upward trend', which is a subjective interpretation forbidden by the prompt. The data line actually fluctuates, increasing from 2016 to 2017, decreasing in 2018, and then increasing again.

errors.text_span: като стойността нараства от приблизително 21.0% през 2017 г. до 25.0% през 2020 г.
errors.evidence: This part of the sentence uses incorrect start and end values to describe the trend. The value in 2017 is approximately 23.6% (not 21.0%) and in 2020 is approximately 23.8% (not 25.0%). This misrepresents the magnitude of the change.
